comment: Changes to /api/v1 since the base release, and to what packages/* export since the parent commit, each accepted on purpose as the exact line scripts/contract-check.mjs prints, with the PR that made it and why installed clients are safe (or BREAKING). CI fails on any other line, and on an openapi line it no longer prints: remove those once a release containing them is the base.

Documents an existing answer: v0.10.1 already answered 409 (ApiError) to a resend of a used invitation or without email; #976 adds the conflict of an invitation whose access has ended. Clients show the error.

New answer: linking a character card a crew row already plays now gives 409 ApiError (code conflict, details.reason character_taken, details.member) instead of a second row, for every client; servers that do so advertise crew-one-row-per-character in /instance/version. An earlier client shows a generic error and the link is not made.
